subject: Urgent: Keep evaluation live during vendor onboarding delay
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@somnihealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@somnihealth.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval access question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the platform looked promising and the engineering team is excited. Quick heads-up from procurement/legal: we're delayed onboarding a new vendor because our security team asked for an extra supplier questionnaire and the vendor onboarding team got pulled into a QBR. That has pushed our PO timeline out by 7-10 business days.

We can't risk losing momentum on the POC. Can Redwood temporarily top up our sandbox (or provide a short-term token credit) so the team can keep validating integrations while the PO moves through approvals? Ideally something that keeps the main workflows live for 10 days.

Attached: SomniHealth_PO_draft.pdf — that's where we are with internal approvals. Happy to share any procurement contact if it helps.

Best,
Lisa Gomez
Director, Vendor Ops
SomniHealth Inc.
Attachments: SomniHealth_PO_draft.pdf (pdf, 312KB)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@somnihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Keep evaluation live during vendor onboarding delay

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear note and the PO draft. Understood on the onboarding bottleneck. We definitely want to keep things moving on your side.

Quick proposal to avoid interrupting the POC: we can provision a temporary token credit for SomniHealth for up to 10 days. To keep within internal approvals, I can issue an initial 7-day, 15k-token credit right away and request an extension to 10 days (20k tokens) pending a quick sign-off from Ben/Finance. If procurement needs SSO or IP allowlisting ahead of PO, tell me which environments/ips and we’ll prioritize.

Can you confirm:
- Target expiry window (10 days from today? a specific date?)
- Any production-like traffic (or just test calls + integration checks)

I’m looping in Ben (sales lead) and Camila (CS) to approve the credit and monitor usage. If you want, we can also set a daily usage alert so procurement has visibility.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

Grace / Camila — quick decision here: I’m fine approving the 7-day, 15k-token interim credit so they don't lose momentum. If procurement confirms the PO is actively moving and we have the draft (they attached it), I will authorize stretching to 10 days / 20k tokens. Finance prefers to keep extensions manual so we can review consumption patterns (avoid open-ended credits).

Camila, can you:
- Set up a usage dashboard for SomniHealth and enable daily email alerts to lisa.gomez@somnihealth.com and procurement@somnihealth.com;
- Do a short health check call with their engineering lead once we enable the credit (15–20 minutes).

If both are done, I’ll greenlight the 10-day top-up.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Healthcare Accounts | Redwood Inference

We’ve provisioned a 10-day temporary credit for SomniHealth (20,000 tokens) starting now. Details:
- Account: SomniHealth Inc. (DN-4721)
- Credit: 20,000 tokens valid 2026-02-20 through 2026-03-01 (inclusive)
- Temporary API key: temp_live_key_xxx (expires with the credit) — Camila, please rotate after the window.
- Daily usage dashboard and alerts are live; Camila will add lisa.gomez@somnihealth.com to the alert list.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_v1.docx (for reference). We expect the signed PO to convert this to a paid deployment; please ping me if procurement needs a one-page billing summary to accelerate approvals.

Camila: confirm when the dashboard + health check call are scheduled and I’ll mark this resolved.

Thanks — glad we could keep the team moving.

Best,
